Game Overview

In Nubik Vs Zombies Arena, the core idea is straightforward: join Nubik in a thrilling battle for survival. Enhance your base, upgrade weapons, and recruit mercenaries as you seek the portal to escape. Dive into meditative gameplay where strategy and action blend seamlessly, creating a captivating experience. Will you help Nubik find his way out?
